title: Session listing shows a provider-usage-limit-paused session as "active" with queuePaused false, and later mail reads lose the pause reason
outcome: Session listing shows a provider-usage-limit-paused session as "active" with queuePaused false, and later mail reads lose the pause reason
acceptance: While a root session's wake queue is held by a provider usage limit, termal_list_sessions (and the session listing API) reports that state for the session — e.g. queuePaused true with queuePauseReason naming the provider usage limit and its start time — instead of status active with queuePaused false.

An exact mailbox-message read of a message held behind that pause keeps reporting the pause reason (e.g. recipientQueuePause: provider_usage_limit with its start) for as long as the hold lasts, not only on the first read.

Behaviour tests cover a session paused by a provider usage limit: the listing shows the pause and reason, and repeated exact reads of a held message keep the reason; when the pause clears, both report the session as unpaused.
